comparisons.meaning: same population and K=4; different feature representations and RFM fitting history, not a pure feature-only causal ablation
same preference features and group count, all returning customers
conditional core-only comparison; group counts differ; no full population superiority claim

fallback: For HDBSCAN-assigned returners use frozen group Top10; otherwise use the same frozen global Top10. Never assign a cluster to noise. Compare with global-only and KMeans4 on identical full-returner IDs. No customer outcome used to choose fallback.
condition_policy: Pre-observable descriptive conditions, fixed before this reaggregation, overlap permitted. Never interpret as validated automatic routing thresholds. Same value tiers are original RFM labels.
temporal_policy: New to October snapshot means absent in September eligible IDs, not newly acquired customer. October assignments refit all clusterers; no frozen-model newcomer test.
statistics: Equal person mean of group_hits / all future distinct items among returners. Paired win/loss/tie uses integer hit counts for identical targets. Full customer coverage and future-returner evaluation coverage separated. No confidence intervals treating correlated customer windows as independent.
future_access: Existing known results only. No new source labels, no retraining, no parameter selection.
